measured_outer_batches.scope: Batch wall time includes admission and orchestration; overlaps process seconds above and must not be added to them. Not an end-to-end research-labor or backup measurement.

costs.measurement_gap: The injected post-fit failure has no returned supervisor sample summary; its worker high-water RSS and recorded elapsed time remain in the failed manifest.
costs.scope: All 100 admitted EXP-0010 attempts, including the expected verification failure and eight restored-source replays. Actual full fits are charged even when the selected checkpoint is early. Archive I/O, unit tests, source review and offline report construction are outside these run totals. Dense forward arithmetic is not a full backward/SVD FLOP estimate. Recorded elapsed times are not controlled speed comparisons. View-transform counters measure benchmark observation generation separately from model inference.

decision.dense_remix: Neither frozen arm acquires any seed. Refit_warm acquires two and refit_reset one; no arm advances to mixed fitting or development evaluation.
decision.inference: This trial does not establish reliable reuse of unchanged operations or a practical cost advantage. Refit control competence under translation and preserved reconstruction do not rescue the failed frozen-arm continuation gates. Dense-remix failure does not distinguish optimization from fixed-family capacity.
decision.next: Retain the scoped EXP-0009 acquisition recipe and the complete negative bridge result. No further campaign is admitted by this closure. A later queue decision must state a falsifiable remedy for the acquisition-to-continuation gap before widening scope.
decision.scope: Same fully observed finite world and known regime boundary; underlying development trajectories were already evaluated in EXP-0009. Only their new observation representation is held out from this adaptation campaign. No final trajectories are rendered.
decision.translation: All three frozen_warm seeds acquire, but only one passes development and own-state continuation. Both refit arms pass all three development seeds. Frozen_reset passes only two one-step seeds and does not advance.

inherited_acquisition.earlier_context: EXP-0008 and earlier studies informed the chosen model and optimization comparison; their costs remain in their immutable evidence records. Two-campaign totals do not represent the entire Noetloom research program.
inherited_acquisition.scope: Charge the entire upstream EXP-0009 acquisition, failed comparisons, evaluation and verification campaign once as shared prior acquisition, not once per arm. These are separate from the EXP-0010 budget. Parent lineages remain explicit in the registered protocol.

old_partition_audit.scope: Initial observations and reconstruction targets are audited. Training sees no held-out state; later prefixes may revisit training states. Net computations exclude all permitted training subwords. Final word structures are counted, but final trajectories are never rendered.

input_audit.scope: Finite float32 observations and prefixes from training, validation, development and continuation inputs; no final observations rendered.

preflight.scope: Synthetic numerical and input-integrity checks; not evidence of learned acquisition.

recovery.limitation: Owner-authorized same-disk private duplicate; not an independent failure domain. Existing numerical environment. No artifacts retired.

report_provenance.scope: Offline extraction and deterministic aggregation only; no new model fitting, checkpoint selection or development-quality sweep.

retained_snapshots.scope: Old snapshots are retained byte-for-byte; all new parameter-snapshot identities remain in each attempt artifact inventory. Each active new model has 1780 parameters, of which 1340 coupling parameters receive gradients. Keeping old and new versions is not a shared-parameter interference test. Physical storage is charged without deduplication.

acquisition.mixed_admission: All 24 one-step fits must complete first. Each arm/view may advance only when all three seeds acquire at the single registered rate and each selected parent fully replays.
acquisition.selection: Earliest checkpoint passing every gate; if none passes, retain minimum validation prediction MSE, with earliest step breaking ties. Complete and charge the full fitting duration. Selected development evaluation therefore refers to the observed first acquired snapshot.

selection_and_competence.point_cost_scope: Recorded work through selected one-step plus selected mixed checkpoint; full registered fits still executed and charged separately. Observation exposure dominance requires no greater presentation, forward-prefix, auxiliary-observation and affine-fit-example counters separately.
